# Welch construction with p=11, primitive root 2
p=11
g=2
a=[pow(g,i,p) for i in range(p-1)]
print(a)
x=[v-1 for v in a]
print(x)
# verify Costas
vecs=set()
ok=True
n=len(x)
for c1 in range(n):
    for c2 in range(c1+1,n):
        v=(c2-c1, x[c2]-x[c1])
        if v in vecs:
            ok=False
        vecs.add(v)
print("Costas:",ok, "perm:",sorted(x)==list(range(n)))
